evidenceBoundary.interactionLimit: Current evidence supports static/default control treatment and native-scroll composition only. It does not authorize enabled click/hover/focus/restored behavior.

knowledgeBasis.application: A feature is kept at page or section scope unless the current run shows the same role across independent pages; Pokémon's campaign, database and instruction systems are therefore intentionally not flattened into one universal skin.
Same pixels and frequency do not prove the same semantic role. Home campaign discovery and database Search remain separate treatments.
Identity-bearing navigation, interface palette and action treatment are judged separately. Current default-only evidence cannot approve a global brand-primary or global action token.
Composition and component recipes receive only the narrowest supported page/scenario scope, and still require independent visual QA after implementation.

brandThesis: Pokémon TCG is not expressed by one paint bucket. It is expressed by purpose-specific organisms held together by authentic collectible imagery, forceful italic display hierarchy, hard section boundaries and deliberate responsive re-authoring: cinematic discovery on Home, compact productive density in the card database, and painted diagram-led instruction in Learn.

formulaBoundary.expressive: Use ImageGen later for source-independent expressive scene composition, but never to redraw Pokémon characters, cards, logos or other identity subjects; current evidence defines visual mass, focal hierarchy and neutral identity slots.
formulaBoundary.productive: Read the learned brand system directly: purpose-specific surfaces, typography roles, control recipes, section boundaries and responsive geometry come from this current Evidence chain.
formulaBoundary.expertDecision: Knowledge-base decisions set attention allocation, task-space protection, narrowest reuse scope and responsive strategy; they do not substitute for current source facts.

invariants.rule: Home campaign, database query and Learn instruction remain distinct visual systems; shared brand recognition comes from hierarchy, authentic objects and deliberate boundaries, not one global background color.
Official Pokémon, card and logo assets must remain authentic independent assets. Generated expressive composition may provide the environment but must not redraw identity subjects.
390px layouts re-author order and object pairing rather than uniformly scaling desktop; focal asset weight, section purpose and reading order are preserved.
Dense task pages keep productive controls and readable results dominant; expressive mass cannot consume the database's first-task viewport.

colorRoles.reason: Current identity-bearing Home proves this role at desktop and 390px, but no same-role cross-page action/state set exists.
The color is tied to explanatory diagrams and section containment.
Per primary-color-and-cta, a task-local Search control does not establish global brand or action color.

expressiveDisplay.rule: Use heavy italic uppercase display typography for expressive editorial or instructional headings, with clearly quieter supporting copy.

productiveText.rule: Keep form labels, values and dense task copy restrained and readable; expressive display typography must not enter productive controls.

frameAndBoundary.rule: A near-black stage contains expressive campaign layers, then ends clearly before white editorial content.
Warm and navy painted fields separate different learning models and bind text to authentic cards/diagrams.
A continuous charcoal field groups the entire database query task and keeps labels/inputs/actions in one readable organism.

density.home: Expressive high-mass opening followed by breathable, separately bounded editorial bands.
density.database: High productive density inside one task organism; little decorative mass before the primary query controls.
density.learn: Low-to-medium density in onboarding, then dense paired instruction within strongly bounded painted chapters.

motionAndInteraction.reason: The sole current observation has complete scroll timelines but no fresh action trace with triggered, settled and restored states.

assetUsage.rule: Use official identity assets unchanged and independently layered; no source screenshot may become runtime content and no generated likeness may replace an identity subject.
ImageGen may create a source-independent environment and complete expressive composition around neutral identity slots, while the official assets are fused deterministically afterward.

interactionRecipes.usage: Home campaign discovery action appearance only
notFor: enabled behavior without fresh action evidence
enabled search behavior without fresh action evidence

sources.treatment: white fill / black text on dark campaign
orange fill / white text in charcoal query field

primaryActionReview.identityVsActionDecision: The black Home cap is an identity/navigation field, not an action token. Campaign discovery and database Search are different semantic roles and remain scoped.
exceptions: Database orange Search is local to query execution.
White Home campaign actions depend on the dark expressive stage.
primaryActionReview.approvalBoundary: No global primary-action or brand-primary token is approved from this run.

semanticClaims.scope: Home navigation and campaign surround only

patterns.meaning: A dominant expressive campaign with distinct official identity layers precedes productive editorial discovery.
Distinct image/copy bands carry discovery from news through ecosystem, event, play and product content.
requiredMechanisms: one dominant image/copy relationship per band

patterns.meaning: One continuous charcoal field holds the complete query-building task with restrained typography and a single local orange Search action.
Warm card-anatomy and navy play-field chapters bind explanatory terms to authentic objects using contrasting painted boundaries.
Long pages remain sequences of purpose-specific organisms; responsive design preserves each organism's task and reading order.

color.priorityReason: Both are high-salience current observations tied to different page purposes and backgrounds; neither has the same-role state set required for a global token.
color.reason: Keep them as Home identity-stage and Learn instructional-field recipes; do not collapse them into brand-primary.
color.styleRecipe: home-identity-cap=black/white; learn-field=deep-navy/white-light-blue; each limited to its evidenced organism

typography.priorityReason: Current desktop and mobile evidence shows display hierarchy is visually dominant and task-relevant, while productive controls use a quieter system.
typography.reason: Apply the heavy italic uppercase display role only to expressive headings and preserve readable system text in productive regions.
typography.styleRecipe: expressive-display: heavy italic uppercase, high contrast, compact line-height; productive-copy remains restrained

radius.priorityReason: The current high-salience campaign action proves a local silhouette in one default state, not a global control family.
radius.reason: Map only to the Home campaign-discovery component variant.

spacing.priorityReason: Current campaign action spacing materially controls legibility and visual weight, but only one component role is proven.
spacing.reason: Map the observed padding to the campaign-discovery variant and retain productive-control density elsewhere.

shadow.priorityReason: A visible high-salience lift exists on the campaign action, but no cross-page shadow system or state set is available.
shadow.reason: Keep the lift inside the campaign action recipe only.

action-color.priorityReason: Both current controls are high-salience and task-relevant, but they perform different semantic jobs and only default states are observed.
action-color.reason: Per the CTA policy, keep white campaign-discovery and orange database-search as separate component recipes; global primary-action remains unresolved.
action-color.styleRecipe: campaign-discovery=white/black on dark stage; database-search=rgb(238,107,47)/white in charcoal query organism

unresolvedClaims.reason: Fresh action traces for triggered, settled and restored states are absent.
Same-role cross-page and hover/focus evidence is absent; campaign discovery and database Search are different jobs.
Current evidence supports the instructional color role, not an exact reusable global token.
